title: You Think More Witnesses Mean Faster Help, Yet Four Extra Listeners Cut Rescue to 31%
description:
You think collapsing in a crowd guarantees fast rescue! Yet four extra listeners slashed help below one third! This is the true story of Darley's Intercom Emergency Study. Here is what went wrong with safety in numbers.
